title: Mixed Event — Our Precious Memories — Episode3 The Ultimate Surprise

meta.Event Outline: As the Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy school year draws to a close, Saki revisits her "100 Things I Want To Do" list. She makes up her mind to cross off the whole list, especially No. 95: "Make lots of fun memories and put them in a photo album!"

rows.Line: The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Humhumhuuum♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll achieve “Have a study session at a diner” after practice today... And tomorrow, we'll do “Race into the sunset”!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I sure hope it's sunny!
Oh! I need to decide which embankment we should run along!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You seem excited, Saki.
What are you doing?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Haruka!
Hehe, I was just making plans based on the list of things I want to do♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A list of things you want to do?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! So, in this notebook, I...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see... This notebook must mean a lot to you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
And you'll be making a photo album...
I've never done it myself, but having your very own album does sound special.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
Just one more reason I've gotta keep doing all the remaining stuff on my list♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What do you have left?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, anything in that notebook without a check next to it isn't done yet!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hmm... “Record a challenge video with me and my classmates!”, “Have a chocolate fondue party”... Hehe, these all seem fun.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Don't they?♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What else is there...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Huh...? This one...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh yeah, Haruka, I wanted to ask you something! It's about this “Play dodgeball!” one...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? Dodgeball?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I played it with my classmates all the time during recess in elementary, so I wanted to play it again!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But nobody seems like they'll play dodgeball with me, so I haven't been able to get a group together...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, most people certainly seem to spend their breaks studying or doing things for their clubs...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Would you let me join that dodgeball game? I'll help you get a group together too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? You'll do that?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. After hearing you talk about it, I want to play dodgeball again too...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And I also want to make more memories with you before I switch to the credit-based course.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, if there's anything else I might be able to help you with, please let me know.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, that's the bell!
Gotta get ready for class!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, Haruka, let's talk more later!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mhm, see you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Saki seems like she's enjoying herself...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Still, that list...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Huh...? This one...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (One of the items was “Go to a concert featuring my favorite idol”.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (She meant Airi, right...? She said she'd often watch Airi on variety shows when she was in the hospital.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (In that case...)
The next day - After school

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haruka, when do I take this blindfold off?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe, wait just a little longer.
Oh, there's a step here, so take it slow.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe, I'm fine since I have you as my personal escort!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But what is it you want to show me?
I'm so curious!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Wait just a bit more... Okay, we're here.
I'll take off your blindfold.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wah, it's bright... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Saki! Thank you for coming to our mini-concert today!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're gonna deliver looots of love, so we hope you enjoy every last second!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wha...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whaaaaaaaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haruka, this is...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A special concert just for you, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You had “Go to a concert featuring my favorite idol” written in your notebook.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, I thought we could put on a concert with Airi, your favorite idol.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Just for me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thank you, Haruka...
Thank you all...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're our dear junior, and a treasured fan of MORE MORE JUMP! Of course we'd do this!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, let's get right into our first song!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Th-They're sooo cute!!!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Minori and Haruka are so different from when we're hanging out together!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I can tell they're going all out to bring me joy... They're so dazzling!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ahhhh!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Shizuku is so pretty...! Her dancing and singing are both so great it's hard to take my eyes off of her!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (And, and...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Airi—not Airi from my school—Airi the idol is right here in front of me...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (The same cheerful, funny, super adorable Airi who helped me stick through all those times in the hospital...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka, Shizuku & Airi
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Phew... How was that, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Absolutely fantastic!!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm really moved...
Um, thank you all, thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe, so does that mean you accomplished that item on your list?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes...! In the best way possible...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, Haruka!
This was such a thoughtful surprise...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm so happy, I just... I'm so happy!!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Groan*
I want to tell you how happy I am, but I don't know how to say it... I can't believe myself!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe, that told us plenty.
I'm glad you enjoyed it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh yeah!
You're making a photo album, right Saki? Haruka mentioned it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, let's take a picture!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, a picture...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of you and us, of course!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
M-Me and all of you?!
Is that okay?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Th-Then... Please!
I'll take a selfie, so can you all come into the frame?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ready?
Say cheese!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How is it? Did it turn out well?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes...! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, next... Saki, come here!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh...? N-Next to you...?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I-I'm here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now, can you curve your right hand into a “C” shape?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A “C”? Oh, is this...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Now take that hand, and put it next to my left hand...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There, we're doing the Momoi pose!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
W-Wooow...!
I'm doing the Momoi pose with Airi...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, you both look adorable.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Saki, look over here at my camera, just like that! Say cheese!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay, I got a really great picture!
Check it out, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow... A shot of me and Airi, it's like a dream...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe, that's a bit over the top.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I-It's not over the top at all!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you sooo much, for the concert and the pictures! The memories I made today... I'll treasure them forever and ever!
